newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MANCHESTER CITY COMPLETE GEORGIAN HAT-TRICK.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MANCHESTER CITY COMPLETE GEORGIAN HAT-TRICK.

text.p: English division one team Manchester City underlined their admiration for Georgian footballers by signing a third player from the former Soviet republic on Saturday.
City agreed a 350,000 pounds sterling ($558,700) deal with German club Frankfurt for Georgia's 28-year-old captain Kakhaber Tskhadadze, subject to him being granted a work permit.
Steve Coppell, the Manchester side's manager, said: "I believe defenders only really mature at his age and think the best of him has yet to come."
Tskhadadze is to link up at City with compatriots Georgi Kinkladze and Mikhail Kavelashvili.
